address: Plaza de España 7, A Coruña, 15001, Spain
bio: An attractive bistro-style taberna featuring a terrace, a bar where guests can also choose to eat if they wish, and two dining rooms with stone walls. The updated take on traditional cuisine perfect for sharing includes seasonal and market-inspired dishes, daily suggestions and Miga’s signature dishes such as the langoustine salad, the exquisite aged-beef tartare, and the boneless tripe stew (“callos de Miga”)....
